---
title: "01 — Single resonance (SHO)"
---

The smallest complete system-identification experiment: a simple harmonic oscillator
at 1 Hz with Q = 20.  We design an optimal excitation, quantify the variance reduction
versus a flat drive, and recover the model from a noisy measurement.

This example is intentionally minimal — one mode, synthetic noise, no hardware — so
the signal flow is clear before the ladder adds complexity.

```{python}
import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

from system_ident.model import TFModel
from system_ident.fisher import parameter_covariance
from system_ident.design.pintelon import optimal_excitation
from system_ident.estimators.invfreqs import InvfreqsEstimator

# ── plant and prior ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
true  = TFModel.from_resonances([(1.0, 20.0)], gain=1.0)   # 1 Hz, Q = 20
prior = TFModel.from_resonances([(0.95, 18.0)], gain=1.1)  # 5% wrong in f0, 10% in Q

freq   = np.linspace(0.2, 3.0, 400)
Pyy    = np.ones_like(freq)          # white readout noise
Px_tot = 1.0                         # fixed drive-power budget

Pxx_opt  = optimal_excitation(freq, prior, Pyy, Px_tot, n_iter=6)
Pxx_flat = np.full_like(freq, Px_tot / (freq[-1] - freq[0]))
```

## Designed excitation vs the plant

```{python}
#| label: fig-sho-excitation
#| fig-cap: "Optimal drive concentrates power at the 1 Hz resonance; flat drive spreads it uniformly. Hover to read exact values."

T_tot    = 256.0
cov_opt  = parameter_covariance(freq, true, Pxx_opt,  Pyy, T_tot)
cov_flat = parameter_covariance(freq, true, Pxx_flat, Pyy, T_tot)
ratio    = np.max(np.diag(cov_flat)) / np.max(np.diag(cov_opt))

SKY  = '#1F8AC0'
GOLD = '#C8973A'
GRAY = '#94A3B8'
resp = np.abs(true.eval(freq))

fig = make_subplots(
    rows=2, cols=1, shared_xaxes=True,
    subplot_titles=[
        '<b>Plant magnitude</b>  |G(f)|',
        f'<b>Excitation design</b>  — {ratio:.0f}× variance reduction over flat',
    ],
    vertical_spacing=0.08,
)

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=freq, y=resp, mode='lines',
    line=dict(color=SKY, width=2.5), name='|G(f)| — true plant',
    hovertemplate='%{x:.3f} Hz   |G| = %{y:.4f}<extra></extra>',
), row=1, col=1)

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=freq, y=resp * 0 + 0,  # invisible, just for prior overlay
    mode='lines', line=dict(color='rgba(200,151,58,0.4)', width=1.5, dash='dot'),
    showlegend=False,
), row=1, col=1)

# Mark resonance
f0_idx = np.argmax(resp)
fig.add_annotation(
    x=freq[f0_idx], y=resp[f0_idx], xref='x', yref='y',
    text='<b>f₀ = 1.0 Hz, Q = 20</b>', showarrow=True,
    arrowhead=2, arrowsize=1.1, arrowcolor='rgba(200,151,58,0.7)',
    ax=60, ay=-38, font=dict(size=11, color=GOLD, family='Outfit, sans-serif'),
    row=1, col=1,
)

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=freq, y=np.sqrt(Pxx_opt),
    mode='lines', fill='tozeroy', fillcolor='rgba(200,151,58,0.15)',
    line=dict(color=GOLD, width=2.5), name='Optimal  (Fisher-matched)',
    hovertemplate='%{x:.3f} Hz   ASD = %{y:.4f}<extra></extra>',
), row=2, col=1)

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=freq, y=np.sqrt(Pxx_flat),
    mode='lines', line=dict(color=GRAY, width=1.8, dash='dash'),
    name='Flat  (equal total power)',
    hovertemplate='%{x:.3f} Hz   ASD = %{y:.4f}<extra></extra>',
), row=2, col=1)

fig.update_layout(
    template='plotly_white', height=500,
    margin=dict(l=60, r=20, t=50, b=55),
    font=dict(family='Outfit, Inter, sans-serif', size=12),
    legend=dict(orientation='h', yanchor='bottom', y=1.02, xanchor='right', x=1,
                bgcolor='rgba(255,255,255,0.9)', bordercolor='#DCE5F0', borderwidth=1),
)
fig.update_yaxes(title_text='|G(f)|',         type='log', row=1, col=1, gridcolor='rgba(30,60,100,0.07)')
fig.update_yaxes(title_text='Drive ASD',                  row=2, col=1, gridcolor='rgba(30,60,100,0.07)')
fig.update_xaxes(title_text='Frequency  [Hz]',            row=2, col=1, gridcolor='rgba(30,60,100,0.07)')
fig.update_xaxes(gridcolor='rgba(30,60,100,0.07)',        row=1, col=1)
fig.show()
```

## Parameter variance: same power, lower uncertainty

```{python}
print(f"Measurement time T = {T_tot} s")
print()
print(f"  Flat (equal power)  — max parameter variance: {np.max(np.diag(cov_flat)):.3e}")
print(f"  Optimal             — max parameter variance: {np.max(np.diag(cov_opt)):.3e}")
print(f"  Variance ratio:  {ratio:.1f}×  (optimal is {ratio:.0f}x better)")
```

::: {.callout-note}
The {ratio:.0f}× reduction in worst-parameter variance does not require any extra
measurement time or drive power — only a smarter allocation of the same budget.
:::

## Model recovery from a noisy measurement

We simulate a 2%-noise measurement and fit the model from the prior:

```{python}
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
H      = true.eval(freq)
H_err  = np.abs(H) * 0.02
H_meas = H + (rng.standard_normal(freq.size) + 1j * rng.standard_normal(freq.size)) * H_err / np.sqrt(2)

fit = InvfreqsEstimator().fit(freq, H_meas, H_err, prior)

print("True model  den:", np.round(true.den, 4))
print("Prior model den:", np.round(prior.den, 4))
print("Fitted      den:", np.round(fit.den,  4))
```

## Recovered vs measured vs true

```{python}
#| label: fig-sho-fit
#| fig-cap: "Noisy measurement and recovered model overlay on the true plant. Zoom in near 1 Hz to compare."

fig2 = go.Figure()

fig2.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=freq, y=np.abs(H), mode='lines',
    line=dict(color=SKY, width=2.5), name='True plant',
    hovertemplate='%{x:.3f} Hz   |G| = %{y:.4f}<extra></extra>',
))
fig2.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=freq, y=np.abs(H_meas), mode='markers',
    marker=dict(color='rgba(148,163,184,0.5)', size=3), name='Measured (2% noise)',
    hovertemplate='%{x:.3f} Hz   |Hmeas| = %{y:.4f}<extra></extra>',
))
fig2.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=freq, y=np.abs(fit.eval(freq)), mode='lines',
    line=dict(color=GOLD, width=2.0, dash='dash'), name='Fitted model',
    hovertemplate='%{x:.3f} Hz   |G_fit| = %{y:.4f}<extra></extra>',
))

fig2.update_layout(
    template='plotly_white', height=360,
    margin=dict(l=60, r=20, t=20, b=55),
    font=dict(family='Outfit, Inter, sans-serif', size=12),
    legend=dict(orientation='h', yanchor='bottom', y=1.02, xanchor='right', x=1,
                bgcolor='rgba(255,255,255,0.9)', bordercolor='#DCE5F0', borderwidth=1),
    xaxis=dict(title='Frequency  [Hz]', gridcolor='rgba(30,60,100,0.07)'),
    yaxis=dict(title='|G(f)|', type='log', gridcolor='rgba(30,60,100,0.07)'),
)
fig2.show()
```
